analytics.name: Analytic 1791
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Phishing by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: open() with O_CREAT for APK file in /sdcard/ or /data/local/tmp/ within $PhishingWindow$ of navigation to flagged URL — APK drop confirms malware delivery phase]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [execve() from APK installed within $PhishingWindow$ of navigation to flagged URL — first execution confirms malware activation]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 50/100. Derive from threat intel feed vendor scoring.
Default 30 days — newly registered phishing domains.
Default 300s from URL navigation to APK install and execution.
